page.layout: One column of running text. Printed page 177 at top right, with running head "PARS SECVNDA." at top centre. One marginal note at the right, beside the first line. Left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Signature "S 3" and catchword "ceptā" at the foot.

main_text.l: Illius nostri cælestis qui facit ut sol suus exoria-
tur super malos & bonos, & pluit super iustos
ac iniustos, non ulla dignitate aut virtute no-
stra adductus, sed sola benignitate & munifi-
centia sua. quid enim terra ad rorem supernè
obtinendum facit? Deus idem auctor est & fa-
ciendi & demittendi roris: eam non terra me-
retur; sed largitur gratia, qua naturæ ordinem
constituit Deus. Vt itaq. nec Hermon, nec Sion
fecerunt quidquam ad habendum rorem; ita
etiam de nobis profiteamur coram Domino
necesse est. Descendit amor infinitus illius ad
nos vehementissimè; at non vicissim ad illum
ascendit pusillus noster: efficit ille amor & ro-
rem benedictionum & effecta singula ex rore
illo procedentia. Nos igitur, qui tam gratiosa
benignitate patris cælestis nostri in communione
sanctorum participes efficimur roris cælestis ill-
ius; quo studio, qua contentione tenemur la-
borare, obsecro, ut istas benedictiones Dei r-
efundamus, & gratum animum nostrum omni
officio ac potius pietate Deo testatum faciamus?
- At non refundit terra, nec reppendit cælo, à quo
perfusa est. bene est: Nam eadem quoque ra-
tione res à se acceptas per nos Deus refundi
postulat; Nec terra refundit cælo, nec nos Do-
mino refundimus; sed cum terra refundat crea-
tis rebus aliis, in quarum commodum fructus
ipsius instituti sunt, ac proinde hominibus ipsis
sit parens & altrix benefica; utrumque nobis
tenendum est; nec posse nos Deo beneficia accepta

page.notes: Left-edge fragments (ipi, bis, etc.) are show-through or the neighbouring page and are omitted. Catchword "ceptā" is the first word of the next page, printed with a macron over the a. The paragraph break before "- At non" is inferred from the dash opening the line. Uncertain readings: "reppendit" and the marginal reference "Mat.5." (printed as "Mat.5:" in the scan) are copied as best read.
